readings.moment: Lina came down into the kitchen (thirteen minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
Madame's piano began (two minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock)
The temple struck eleven, while Lina was still in the kitchen
Madame's piano stopped (eleven minutes past eleven by the kitchen clock)
The hall clock struck eleven while the kitchen clock showed thirteen minutes past eleven

durations: A quarter of an hour: the kitchen clock runs a quarter hour fast
About 13 minutes: the piano played from 10:58 to 11:11 by the kitchen clock
Lina stayed in the kitchen from 10:47 (kitchen clock) until after the temple struck eleven
whereabouts: Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:47 by the kitchen clock
Lina stayed with Rosa in the kitchen until after the temple struck eleven
Lina sat on the stool in the kitchen
Rosa and Lina sat in the kitchen and listened to Madame's piano
Rosa went up the back stairs to the atelier after the hall clock struck eleven
Rosa called to the master in the atelier and he did not answer
The master was on the floor in the atelier under the long windows
Rosa went down from the atelier, walking rather than running
